scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/contracts/*.test.mjs && vitest run tests/store
scripts.contracts:drift-check: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && CONTRACTS_GENERATED_DIR="$tmp/ts" CONTRACTS_RUST_GENERATED_DIR="$tmp/rust" node contracts/tools/generate-contracts.mjs && diff -ru src/generated/contracts "$tmp/ts" && diff -ru src-tauri/src/generated/contracts "$tmp/rust"
scripts.verify:contracts: npm run contracts:validate && npm run contracts:golden && npm run contracts:drift-check
